text:
liam: Quick alignment needed 1: routing guardrails + multi-region isolation roadmap for commercial readiness. Sales insists on clear launch criteria we can include in contracts.

sana: Agreed. Let's break into three deliverable buckets: primitives (policy knobs), operational controls (canary + runbooks), and commercial-grade lanes (reserved + residency).

grace: Can we be explicit on timelines? Sales wants <120d for something they can show customers.

sana: Proposal: Sprint 0 (0-60d) 3 primitives + telemetry; Sprint 1 (60-150d)   tenant lanes + 7d canary; Sprint 2 (>150d)  policy DSL + active-active.

keiko: Ops requirements to gate commercial launch: emitted telemetry contract, runbook drill completed, auto-fallback SLI implemented, and a perf canary passing for 7 days.

tara: Sales priority list: 1) per-region data residency, 2) dedicated capacity option, 3) deterministic tail latency for p99. Those map directly to revenue.

liam: Acceptance criteria draft to use in spec:
- Canary: 7d, 5-10% traffic across two region pairs
- Performance: p95/p99 within 15% of baseline; no KV divergence
- Ops: runbook scenario executed once; rollback path validated in <10m
- Compatibility matrix published covering top 6 model families

sana: Example minimal policy payload to show intent:
```
policy: {
  id: "cust_regional_pref_v1",
  priorities: ["residency","latency"],
  allowed_regions: ["us-west1","asia-east1"],
  fallback: { type: "global_pool", max_spill: 0.1 }
}
```
Use this in docs so sales can explain behavior.

keiko: Telemetry events we need (mandatory): policy_decision.{tenant,policy_id,reason}, route_selection.{tenant,region,latency_ms}, route_fallback.{tenant,reason}. Events must be emitted synchronously for canary.

grace: Compatibility spike ask: 10 working days to produce matrix and unit-cost uplift per compatibility band. This is required before we price lanes.

liam: Who owns the one-pager we hand to customers? I volunteer to draft the commercial one-pager if Sana owns the technical acceptance criteria.

sana: I'll own acceptance criteria + canary plan + telemetry list. Grace to run compatibility spike. Keiko to own runbook drill and rollback automation.

ops-bot: Canary scheduled: perf-harness job queued for 06:00 UTC tomorrow  owner: sana.

sales-bot: Note: two enterprise prospects indicated this doc will unblock procurement. Please prioritize.

keiko: Small ops detail: eviction behavior must be explicit. Suggest policy fields: eviction.soft_fraction and eviction.hard_fraction and ordered mitigation steps (reduce batch size, degrade model to fallback family, spill).

liam: Add a customer-facing FAQ to explain overflow and pricing. Keep it one paragraph + three bullets.

sana: I'll post the first draft in #product by Tue EOD. Grace to share spike plan in 48h. Meeting to review draft Wed 14:00 UTC.

liam: Good. Final ask  make sure launch language says "eligible for SLA" only once canary + runbook + compatibility matrix are done. No soft promises before that. :thumbsup:
